question.text: Food preservatives prevent microbial growth and avoid spoilage of food. Which is the commonly used preservative

options.text: Salts of sorbic acid and propanoic acid .

Vegetable oils and sodium benzoate <math><mo>(</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>)</mo></math> .

solution.text: The commonly used preservatives added in the food are table salt, sugar, vegetable oils and sodium benzoate, <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></math> . Sodium benzoate is used in limited quantities and is metabolised in the body. Salts of sorbic acid and propanoic acid are also used as preservatives.
